title: Admin advances an order through fulfilment without going backwards

card.i_want: to move a paid order through packing, dispatch and delivery, and cancel it only before packing
card.so_that: the customer-visible status is always true and a delivered order can never be rewritten

intent: The status a customer sees becomes trustworthy, and the merchant gets an audit trail that stands up in a dispute.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an admin advances a paid order to delivered
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin moves it to packing, then to shipped with a tracking number, then to delivered
then: each transition is accepted in order
the customer-visible timeline shows all three with their times

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: dispatch without a tracking number is refused
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin marks it shipped with an empty tracking number
then: the transition is refused and the order stays in packing

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an order cannot move backwards from shipped
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin attempts to move it back to packing
then: the transition is refused and the order stays shipped

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a delivered order cannot be cancelled
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin attempts to cancel it
then: the cancellation is refused and the order stays delivered

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an admin cancels a paid order before packing with a reason
given: an order in paid that has not started packing
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin cancels it with a reason
then: the order moves to cancelled and its stock returns to available
the reason is recorded in the audit trail

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: cancellation after packing has started is refused
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin attempts a pre-packing cancellation
then: the cancellation is refused and the order stays in packing

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a refund above the dual-approval threshold needs two approvers
given: a cancelled paid order whose refund is 3500 THB
then: it is held until both Finance and the Merchant Owner have approved
it carries an idempotency key so it cannot be paid twice

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a refund at exactly the threshold does not need dual approval
given: a cancelled paid order whose refund is exactly 3000 THB
then: a single Finance approval is sufficient

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: only an admin may advance an order
acceptance_criteria.when: it attempts to move an order to shipped
then: the attempt is refused and the order is unchanged

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a resubmitted transition does not append a second timeline entry
given: an order already moved from paid to packing
acceptance_criteria.when: the same paid-to-packing transition is submitted again after a client retry
then: the order stays in packing with no second state change
the customer-visible timeline shows one packing entry

given: any accepted or refused status change
then: the actor, the time, the from-state, the to-state and any reason are present

pii_fields.justification: the fulfilment view renders the customer name and shipping address to staff
pii_fields.treatment: shown to the back office only; redacted in non-order logs

audit_events.justification: every status change must record who, when and from which state

idempotency.justification: a resubmitted transition must not append a second timeline entry
idempotency.treatment: transition keyed to the from-state so a repeat is a no-op

reversibility.justification: a pre-packing cancellation of a paid order returns stock and opens a manual refund
reversibility.compensating_action: release the sold units and record a manual refund, dual-approved above 3,000 THB

authn_authz.justification: only an admin may advance an order; the pre-packing cancellation is approved by the Operations Lead

regulatory.justification: the Revenue Code 5-year envelope covers the order and audit records; refunds follow the Finance-owned manual SOP

tipping_off.justification: cancellation reasons are internal; no customer-facing wording implies wrongdoing

edge_case_ledger.justification: all derivations for a state-transition rule of this shape were written, including the replay case its idempotency row claims
a terminal state has no magnitude

cases_written: dispatch with an empty tracking number refused
edge_case_ledger.justification: the transition is performed by one admin against one order

cases_written: cancel before packing with a reason
edge_case_ledger.justification: both sides of the packing boundary were written

cases_written: above the 3000 THB threshold needs two approvers
edge_case_ledger.justification: the refund carries an idempotency key whose replay case is covered under RULE-PAYMENT-01
an attribution constraint has no magnitude
